vfx_charge.png:
An energy-gathering 'charging up' effect: concentric golden-orange rings and small light sparks being pulled inward toward the centre, with a bright core and a few upward motion streaks.
The reference image shows the style of this game's existing effect sprites (bold cartoon, thick outlines, flat colours with soft glow). Match it. One single effect graphic, centred, filling most of the canvas. Nothing else in the picture: no character, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. The effect itself must contain no green.
Output 512x512 PNG. Save the image as vfx_charge.png in the current directory and report the path.
